text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle won the Arima Kinen,
splendidly defeating this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)
Umamusume, Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I won... I won...!
Against Kris S-chan, no less~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
On the stage of the Arima Kinen...
But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—The brilliance of her running.
I really thought I'd gotten much closer to Kris S-chan's level...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I won, but...
Still...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
—Hishi Miracle.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kris S-chan...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—She is evolving.
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: With this—the prelude has come to an end.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Finally... we can begin.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kris S-chan... I...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm super bad at English.
I just don't get it at all~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Prelude means...
it's only just begun, right...?"
And on the way home that day—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Kris S-chan is amazing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'd thought so before, but still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I didn't understand at all.
Just how truly incredible it was...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I finally understand now. Now that I'm able
to run reasonably well myself, at long last...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whether she wins or loses,
Kris S-chan is always looking toward her goal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't slack off or get cocky
like normal people do...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Her mindset is completely different...
Maybe to Kris S-chan...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: "That glory... Even winning the Autumn Tenno Sho in her Classic year..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: This is just the beginning...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She'll get so much stronger from here on out.
Because her "resolve" is on a whole other level.

A difference in "resolve." Something I knew—
yet hadn't truly grasped until now.

Today, Hishi Miracle seemed to vividly
realize the fundamental difference between them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Can I... really keep up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: I somehow managed to pull through this year, but I don't feel like I can keep coasting along like this next year.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"In the end... I'm still just me.
Even if I've grown a little bit..."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Will I really be able to manage going forward?

I won't say it forcefully.
I'll simply and quietly convey my conviction.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah... It's because I wanted to answer those words that I've made it this far, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, even if it's a lie, I just wanna let Trainer hype me up like this.
Ahaha...
"An unforgettable bitterness. Even so, Hishi Miracle offered a faint smile..."

"Harboring a sliver of hope and a mountain of anxiety,
her Classic year thus came to a close."
